series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a consistent downward trend with moderate seasonality. Concept drift and unstable model rankings necessitate a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adaptation to account for shifting model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift necessitates dynamic error weighting (ADE) to adapt to shifting model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → shrinkage prevents overfitting with n_windows=2; top_k=4 aligns with recommended_knobs.top_k=4
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection exploits differing model performance across forecast horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → regularization with few windows (n_windows=2) makes ridge_stacking unstable
